what: Fix request (01240 was an FYI and was closed): round 7c (adc8bbbf04) blaze-query --lib still fails tests::a_warm_miss_allocates_at_most_a_segment (src/tests.rs:1226), 2 allocations / 8241 bytes against a budget of 1.
